;A complex of 1x10^-4 M T7 DNA polymerase 5A7A:thioredoxin was assembled  
with an equimolar amount of  double stranded DNA substrate. 
 
Crystallization  
was achieved using a buffer containing 50mM HEPES pH 7.5, 10mM MgCl_2,  
2mM DTT, and 0.5 mM terminal ddTTP Seed crystals were grown by hanging  
drop vapor diffusion by mixing 1ul each of protein-DNA solution and a   
reservoir solutions containing between 16 to 20% PEG 8000, 100mM ACES pH  
7.5, 120 ammonium sulfate, 30mM MgCl2, and 5mM DTT. These crystals  
were used to streak-seed a grid of protein/reservoir solutions with  
concentrations of PEG 8000 between 13 to 15%. Pyramidal crystals  
appeared overnight and reached a maximum size of ~150 X 150 X 100 um3  
after 3 to 4 days. Crystals were harvested overnight in mother-liquor  
containing 10 % PEG 400, temperature 273K, VAPOR DIFFUSION, HANGING DROP
